{"path": "iio_read.py", "content": "def read_samples(buf_fd, n, scan_size):
    # Each whole scan element is scan_size bytes (derived from the enabled channels + their storage bits).
    # Read in whole-scan units and verify the returned byte count so partial / misaligned data is rejected.
    want = scan_size * n
    data = buf_fd.read(scan_size * n)
    if data is None or len(data) != want:
        return b''
    return data
